paper.title: Adaptive Neural Quantum States: A Recurrent Neural Network Perspective

results.system_description: Heisenberg, 6 × 6 · J = 1 · open · Sz = 0. H = sum_<ij> S_i · S_j; S = sigma/2
results.source_location: Table tab:2D_Results, row 'Static RNN (256)', column Energy
results.eligibility_evidence: Variational energy of the 2D RNN sampled with 10^6 configurations after training (Table tab:2D_Results caption).
results.notes: H = (1/4) sum sigma_i · sigma_j on the 6 x 6 open lattice (Eq. heisenberg), i.e. S = sigma/2; total energy. A positive 2D RNN combined with the Marshall sign rule, exact for this model. The table also gives sigma^2/N, which is not Var(H) in this normalization. Above the exact 6 x 6 energy. The magnetization sector is not stated.
